steps.question: What should control corners say?
steps.why: Rounded by default; each brand sets its own corner.
Each brand sets its own corner through the theme.

steps.pick: size.44

radius.4: We use a 4px corner for Aster's buttons and inputs in order to mark their role as controls in a calm, precise tone, by brand convention. A small radius does this by softening the edge just enough while the sides stay straight. So Aster feels exact and steady, the least round of the three brands, because each brand sets its corners (shape.values) on a neutral base (brand.q1).
